Subject: Procurement + Security — quick follow-up and next steps

Hi Samir & Lena —

Thanks again for taking the time on today's discovery call. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps so we can keep momentum for a Q3 kickoff if Procurement and Security are aligned:

- Commercial path: You mentioned evaluating PO (Net terms) vs corporate card for initial purchase. Can you confirm whether Acme prefers a PO/workflow (vendor onboarding + Net30/Net45) or would you start with a card payment for proof-of-concept? Also curious if Acme would consider AWS Marketplace for procurement (we're listed there).
- Vendor setup: If PO is preferred, please share your vendor setup form (W9/vendor questionnaire) and any billing contact.
- Security gating: Lena — you called out SOC 2 Type II and DPA as blockers for Procurement. We have SOC 2 Type II and a standard DPA; happy to share those and walk through any specific questionnaire items. If helpful I can have our security compliance engineer join a short call.

Proposed next steps:
1) Samir/procurement sends vendor form + preferred billing path (PO vs card) — target EOD Wed 8/12
2) Redwood shares SOC 2 + DPA and proposed SOW/invoice for initial reserved capacity — by Tue 8/11 (I attach a short security one-pager for now)
3) Quick tech/security sync (15–30m) with Lena and our security lead to walk the questionnaire — propose Wed 8/13 at 10am PT (open to other times)

Attachments: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf

If you prefer I can route the documents to your procurement alias instead of Samir directly.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Short answers and items from Procurement's side:

- Billing preference: Acme prefers to pay via PO for any ongoing committed spend. For a short pilot (< $25k) the card is possible but we'd prefer to use PO if Redwood can provide invoices and standard Net30 terms.
- Vendor onboarding: I attached our vendor setup form (vendor_setup_form.pdf) — includes fields for W9, remit-to address, vendor contact, and preferred invoicing cadence. Please confirm you can complete the vendor profile and provide a W9.
- Marketplace: We will evaluate AWS Marketplace, but our finance team often prefers direct vendor relationships for contract terms. Open to a marketplace purchase if pricing and invoicing meet our AP rules.

Security items: Our InfoSec (Lena) will follow up on the SOC 2/DPA and questionnaire.

I'll aim to get the completed procurement intake back to you by Thu 8/13. If you can share SOC 2 and the DPA today, I can attach to the vendor profile.

Regards,
Samir Patel

Thanks Samir & Lena — quick replies inline and next steps from our side.

- PO vs card: Redwood supports both. For PO: we can accept a standard PO and issue monthly invoices with Net30 terms. We can also support annual pre-pay for committed capacity if you want to lock pricing. For pilot purchases under $25k, card is fine if you prefer a faster path.
- Vendor form & W9: Attached is our standard W9 and vendor info; I've also attached our SOC 2 Type II (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf) and our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_2026.pdf).
- Marketplace: We're listed on AWS Marketplace, but as Samir noted, marketplace billing can complicate contract terms — if Acme needs specific indemnities or non-standard terms we'll typically go direct.
- Questionnaire: Happy to complete the Acme questionnaire; however, to be efficient our compliance engineer (Dev Patel) can join the call to either walk it or clarify responses in real time. Dev — can you join Wed 8/13 at 10am PT?

Proposed deliverables from Redwood by EOD Tue 8/11 (sent here): W9, SOC2, DPA, and a draft SOW/invoice for the pilot.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, Redwood_DPA_2026.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf

If that timeline works I will also open a DocuSign for the DPA/SOW once procurement confirms PO path and amount.

Best,
